Appreciate the quick turnaround and the sample attachments, Alex. I've attached our Redwood POC Eval Plan v1 (redwood_poc_eval_plan_v1.pdf) - highlights below and a concise checklist so we can be operational fast.

POC eval highlights / success criteria (v1):
- Quality: top-1 match rate against gold replies >= 85% for core prompt cohort (500 gold labeled examples). We'll also run human eval on a 100-sample random subset for edge-case scoring.
- Latency: 95th percentile <= 500ms for single-turn generation at typical prompt lengths (avg 120 tokens).
- Cost: target inference cost <= $X per 1k tokens (we'll finalize after initial benchmark runs).
- Reliability: <1% error rate over 24h test window.

Ingestion / data requirements (short):
- CSV columns: conversation_id, user_message, system_prompt (optional), gold_reply (optional), timestamp, metadata_tags.
- Redaction guidance: remove direct PII fields; hashed ids okay. If you need, Redwood can accept encrypted ZIP via SFTP - Dev, please see questions below.

Ownership & contacts:
- Redwood: Marissa (overall AE), Dev Patel (ingestion/infra), Rachel Kim (CS evaluation lead).
- Acme: Alex (product lead), Priya (procurement/legal).

Proposed near-term timeline:
- 6/30: Acme provides cleaned prompt CSV + logs / grant Drive access.
- 7/1-7/3: Redwood ingests & runs baseline model + calibration.
- 7/4-7/10: Eval runs (metrics + human spot-checks).
- 7/12: Results review; decide next steps (pilot vs scale).

Thanks - a few technical clarifications from the ingestion/infra side so the pipeline is smooth: 

1) Prompt CSV format: for the eval pipeline we expect one row per prompt. For multi-turn threads include a conversation_id and an ordered turn index column. Sample header we can ingest directly: conversation_id, turn_index, user_message, system_prompt, gold_reply, timestamp, metadata_tags.

2) Sample size guidance: the labeled gold set (for automated scoring) should be 400-600 examples. For broader coverage please include 1.5-2k unlabeled examples for distributional testing.

3) Logs: we only need anonymized telemetry (timestamps, model_id, token_counts, response_latencies). If you prefer to send raw logs, please ensure PII redaction or send via encrypted SFTP. If using Drive, please add redwood-poc@acmecorp.com with Editor access and mark the folder as "Acme POC - sanitized".

4) File naming & checksum: please include a small manifest (manifest.txt) listing filenames + sha256 checksums to help automated ingestion.

5) SOW / procurement: attaching SOW-draft-Acme.pdf for reference - we'll keep procurement conversation parallel.

If you can confirm Drive share and upload by 6/30 EOD, we'll prioritize ingestion on 7/1 morning.

Cheers,
